Google Ads: 2,539 conversions from 13,812 clicks, with $21,471.99 spend ($8.46 per conversion). Performance Max brought the most conversions (1,050), followed by the Brand campaign (493). CallTrackingMetrics: 4,405 calls from Google Ads, 2,912 with the source Google Ads Extension and 1,493 with the source Google Ads.

01Notes

Reading this report

Two short notes before the numbers.

Structure

Two parts

This report has two parts: Google Ads (sections 02 to 06) and CallTrackingMetrics (07). Each part uses only its own data.

Call status

Answered, no answer, busy and completed

The call table is exported exactly as it appears in CallTrackingMetrics. Answered calls were picked up. No answer and busy calls were not, and together they make the Not Answered / Busy tile. Completed is the label CallTrackingMetrics gives some finished calls; they are not counted as not answered.
